name: Julius
shortDescription: Data analysis chat. Plus is $20 per month and a Free plan is listed.
longDescription: Julius's pricing page lists a Free plan and Plus for everyday analysis at $20 per month, or $16 per month when billed annually, with a monthly credit amount on Plus.
pricingNotes: Plus is $20 per month, or $16 per month on the annual price. A Free plan is listed.
bestFor: Asking questions about a spreadsheet in a chat priced on the site
notIdealFor: A team that needs a governed BI deployment
strength: Julius lists a Free plan and a Plus plan at $20 per month for everyday analysis.
weakness: Plus is credit-capped, and the $16 figure is the annual per-month price rather than the monthly plan.

useCaseFit.analyze-data: Chat for data analysis, with Plus at $20 per month and a Free plan listed.
